## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Note that C200 codes generally indicate a 3.692 or 4.083 ratio, while M226 often indicates lower ratios like 3.133. [t461]
- The list provided covers various trim levels including XE, SE, NISMO, and LE. [t461]
- SE KC models show variation between 3.133 and 3.538 depending on the axle configuration. [t461]
- [Partial] 4x4 versions of SE KC typically use a C200 gear with a ratio around 3.692. [t461]
- [Partial] SE CC models often utilize M226 axles with ratios like 3.538 for 4x2 setups. [t461]
- The C200 gear code appears in both 4x2 and 4x4 configurations within this trim. [t461]
- [Partial] Nismo models show ratios ranging from low 3.131 to high 3.692. [t461]
- [Partial] The list indicates that 4x4 NISMO units often favor the C200 gear set. [t461]
- [Partial] LE KC 4x2 units typically run a C200 with a 3.133 ratio. [t461]
- [Partial] [Unverified value] The lowest ratio listed in this chunk is found on the LE CC 4x2 at 3.133. [t461]
